events.detail: The military counterintelligence unit of the Security Service of Ukraine (SSU), with the assistance of the Commander-in-Chief of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, has detained a serviceman in the Donetsk region suspected of providing Russia with the coordinates of Ukrainian Defense Forces units and military facilities.

events.quote: Russian strike hits petrol station in Kharkiv
events.detail: Russian troops have attacked a petrol station in Kharkiv.

events.quote: Air defences shoot down 110 of 155 Russian drones launched against Ukraine overnight

events.quote: Russian drone attack on Kremenchuk injures two

events.detail: Russian troops are making sporadic attempts to advance using armored vehicles in the operational zone of the Operational Task Force South, but Ukrainian defenders are detecting and destroying the vehicles while they are still en route to their intended positions.

events.detail: On November 26 and overnight into November 27, Ukraine's Defense Forces struck Russia's most advanced Buk-M3 surface-to-air missile system, drone command posts and military warehouses in temporarily occupied Ukrainian territories.

events.detail: Following the damage to the Kerch Bridge, the Russian Federation is unable to fully supply Crimea with everything required by the Russian occupying forces; however, they will attempt to route more supplies overland.

events.detail: The operation was carried out by Ukrainian forces in cooperation with the Black Spark resistance movement operating in Russia, the General Staff said.

events.detail: Drones attacked the Russian city of Yefremov in the Tula region overnight on November 27, with explosions reported near a local synthetic rubber plant.

events.quote: Bulgaria holding EU's 22nd Russia sanctions package hostage in bid to extract concessions
events.detail: Bulgaria's push to have the EU allow Russian iron imports to resume comes as Moscow does everything in its power to limit a competitor closer to home from being able to help — Ukraine.

events.detail: The project, first announced in February 2024, has faced repeated delays, with Papperger previously citing bureaucratic hurdles in Ukraine.

events.quote: Enemy attack sparks warehouse fire in Bila Tserkva district
events.detail: In the Bila Tserkva district, a fire has broken out in a warehouse following an enemy attack; emergency services are on the scene.

events.quote: Ukraine's Azov announces 'Hell-3' operation, destroys Russian fuel depot in occupied Donetsk Oblast
events.detail: Russian forces had concealed the fuel depot and attempted to protect it with camouflage, electronic warfare systems and mobile fire groups, but the Ukrainian units managed to destroy both the storage site and its supporting logistics infrastructure, Azov said.

events.quote: Ukraine destroys concealed Russian army oil depot in Operation Hell-3
events.detail: The SxLüd unit of the 1st Corps of the National Guard’s ‘Azov’ and the Signum battalion of the 59th Separate Assault Brigade of Unmanned Systems of the 9th Army Corps destroyed a Russian invaders’ oil depot hidden in the forest as part of Operation ‘Hell-3’.

events.quote: FM Sybiha: Russia seeks to include oil exports in Black Sea agricultural truce deal
events.detail: Ukraine is proposing that the ceasefire agreements in the Black Sea focus on the safety of maritime navigation and the transport of agricultural produce, whilst Russia is attempting to include the issue of oil exports in them.

events.quote: Russian attacks cause power outages in six regions, with Dnipropetrovsk and Kherson most affected
events.detail: Consumers in six Ukrainian regions remained without electricity as of the morning of November 27 following Russian attacks, with significant outages reported in the Dnipropetrovsk and Kherson regions.

events.quote: Russian strikes hit railways and energy infrastructure in nine Ukrainian regions overnight – PM Koretskyi
events.detail: Russian forces targeted infrastructure, industrial facilities and residential buildings in nine Ukrainian regions overnight on November 27, leaving one person dead and at least six others injured.
